method.intervalDefinition: Inclusive number of fully acknowledged+postimage-checked CAS operations, read directly from each outer kernel-components.casCompleted. CAS50..99 means completed counter50..99, not500 growing profiles. Warmup begins only after first genuine verified full-auth database-statistics baseline. Error/cleanup counter290 excluded from steady bins.
method.quantiles: Median (mean of two central observations when even); p95 nearest rank ceil(.95*n)-1; max/min exact. Raw bytes for memory, milliseconds for GC pauses. Quantiles are descriptive, unequal sample counts/durations; no statistical stationarity claim.
method.nodeAndGCAlignment: Exact retained node-memory atMs rows match forward.samples and their durable atUTC. Assign them to the same inclusive completed-CAS intervals using actual outer memory-cas-accepted UTC events. GC counts/pauses assigned by durable callback observedAtUTC, not asserted exact GC start-time grouping; some boundary movement possible.
method.processIdentity: Each process isolated by unique PID within pinned raw snapshots; aliases avoid republishing numeric IDs. Host snapshot PID namespace is not equated to container PID files. PostgREST has one named process. Driver Node identified by overwhelmingly closer same-time RSS correlation to own recorded samples; remaining long-lived Node is gateway by known harness two-node lifetime. Transient stop-helper Node not mixed into steady windows. PostgreSQL remains separate per PID; roles not recorded are unknown.
method.pss: No PSS value available in any retained sample; all status fallback. RSS/Anon are process observations, not unique physical allocations. Never sum per-processRSS,PostgreSQLshared buffers,nonconcurrent medians/maxima.
method.kernelFileSemantics: memory.stat.file includes shmem; report both descriptively without adding them. Common memory.current is sole aggregate; lifetimePeak only historical safety high-water, never a slope or growth trend.
method.noForecast: No extrapolation to500/6500 operations and no subtraction of caches/RSS/claimed395MB. No thresholds changed, no optimization implemented.

fullEndStateBeforeFirstCAS.note: All500-state data seeded and logicalAuth verified before firstCAS. Subsequent CAS only changes revision/probe marker; increasing profile/result population does not explain measured growth.

largestProvenObservedGrowthOwner.allocatorOrRetainedObjectCause: UNKNOWN; no GHC heap/object/allocator trace in existing evidence. Process ownership is established, leak/cache/fragmentation mechanism is not.

plateauAssessment.scope: Only90 completed-count positions across200..289, last block40CAS,one partial failed run. PostgREST median/p95 nearlyflat late, common median rises slightly andp95 rises; transient spread remains large. This is a short late plateau suggestion, not proven stationarity or End500 acceptance.

postgresAndWAL.assessment: PhysicalWAL fixed128MiB and tables showboundedreuse across observed interval; cumulativewritten1.075GB is not RAM/residentdisk. Separate PostgreSQL-process medians stable where persistent, transient peaks remain; no sharedRSS sum.

oneGBWish.assessment: Current complete-data path already exceeds1GB and1GiB in observed commoncurrent/peak. Anonymousmemory alone sometimes exceeds either beforefile/kernel, so cache-only reinterpretation cannot prove1GB. It may be a future optimization aim, not a newly mandatory acceptance threshold. No claim impossible for a different proven optimized path.

remainingRisks: Run ended at290/500, no completed late>=349window or full rest-growth acceptance.
No allocation-object/GHC heap trace; PostgREST process growth does not prove a specific cache/leak/allocator cause.
PSS unavailable,role mapping of PostgreSQL children unavailable; individual counters may include sharedpages and are not additive.
